youtube.title: Why Your Foot Falls Asleep 🦶 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Your foot doesn't really fall asleep. Sitting on your leg squeezes its nerves and the blood vessels that feed them, so they stop sending signals and the foot goes numb. When the pressure lifts, the nerves wake up all at once and fire random signals: pins and needles.

Watch our full episodes on the channel.
